author: Wakinah-Entreprise
description: Public MCP server for La Demeure des Dix, a privatized holiday house for 10 guests near Rouen, Normandy: property info, dog stays, house rules, booking options, availability, quotes.
name: La Demeure des Dix

tools.name: get_property_information
tools.title: Discover La Demeure des Dix
tools.description: Public verified description, capacity and facilities of the fully privatized property near Rouen. French source text may be translated by the assistant.

tools.name: get_dog_information
tools.title: Plan a stay with your dog — QUALIDOG and FAQ
tools.description: Public QUALIDOG label and dog-stay FAQ in French, English, German or Dutch, with canonical sources. Covers prior host approval, fees, enclosed garden, preparing your stay and local outings. Checked against current property rules and fees; never approves a dog or confirms a booking.

tools.name: get_stay_rules
tools.title: Stay rules and fees
tools.description: Public check-in, check-out, group, dog, cleaning and event rules. Every dog needs prior host approval. Amounts are EUR minor units and do not replace a live total quote.

tools.name: get_booking_options
tools.title: Official booking and contact links
tools.description: Official website, booking page and public contact. Booking and payment are completed on the official site, never inside this AI tool.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.title: Check one stay
tools.description: Check a bounded stay against the live authoritative calendar. An unknown source returns source_unavailable; a positive result never holds inventory or approves dogs.

dogs.description: Number of companion dogs; every dog requires prior host approval

tools.name: get_quote
tools.title: Get a complete live quote
tools.description: Return a verified total in EUR minor units only when live availability, rates, fees and taxes are complete. A priced dog stay still needs host approval. Otherwise report incomplete or source_unavailable, never an estimated total.
